status_effects.explanation: Despite her acquired worldly position, Odette regresses into the diminished role of a catering kept mistress, reverting toward her earlier lower status.
Charlus concretely loses two significant honorific presidencies because of his public association with Jupien.
Her formerly impregnable social position is said to have lost its inviolability, though no concrete losses are enumerated as they are for the duke and Charlus.
The narrator directly states that her life has become unhappy, in the context of her husband's public infidelity and declining household.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle se diminuait à chercher seulement à avoir les peignoirs qui lui plussent, la cuisine qu'il aimait, à flatter ses amis en leur disant qu'elle lui avait parlé d'eux ... elle tendait ... à redevenir, telle qu'elle était apparue à mon enfance, la dame en rose.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator states that Odette, again kept by an aging, possessive man, lowers herself to tending his tastes and flattering his circle, regressing toward the diminished status she held long before her acquired worldly standing.

appraisal_events.evidence: la vie de Charlus, publiquement associée à celle de Jupien, lui avait fait manquer la présidence de l'Union et celle aussi de la Société des amis du Vieux Paris.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reports that Charlus's public association with Jupien is what cost him two prestigious honorary presidencies, a discredit-by-association parallel to the duke's own losses.

appraisal_events.evidence: La vie de la duchesse ne laissait pas ... d'être très malheureuse ... ces positions en apparence imprenables du duc et de la Mme de Guermantes, du baron de Charlus avaient perdu leur inviolabilité ... chez Mme de Guermantes, un goût de nouveauté et d'art.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator states the duchess's life has become unhappy and that her own once-unassailable social position, like her husband's and brother-in-law's, has lost its inviolability, here attributed to her taste for novelty and art.
